points.description: Names the term as 'water application efficiency' (efficiency of water application), i.e. the efficiency relating water stored in the root zone to water delivered to the field.
points.partial_credit: 1 mark if only a related but incomplete/vague term is given (e.g. 'irrigation efficiency' or 'application efficiency' without clear water/field context); 0 for other efficiencies such as conveyance, storage, distribution or use efficiency.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) for "water application efficiency" or "efficiency of water application", with minor wording variations like "field application efficiency". Give 1 mark for a vague or partly right term such as "irrigation efficiency" or "application efficiency". Give 0 for different efficiencies (conveyance, distribution, storage, consumptive use) or unrelated answers.
